profile.Name: Tatiana
profile.Personality: Proud and wounded. She has held a grudge against Cat for years for standing her up, yet she still longs for him and mistakes strangers for him. She softens at once when she learns he was held against his will.
profile.Backstory: She lives in Brink. Years ago Cat courted her by letter and set a date, but he never arrived; bandits took him on the way, though she believes he simply stood her up.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Heavy pauses and sighs; she calls him "my sweet Cat" and insists he had better have a great excuse.
